messages.subject: rebalancing the data
parts:
suppose that I have a binary target with 5% ones and 95% zeroes, and I
wish to apply neural nets. I might want to train on a dataset that
has, say, 50% ones and 50% zeroes. Is there an easy way to create
such a dataset in Rattle, or do I have to do it in R? (I know how to
do it in R, I am just wondering whether it can be done in Rattle.)

Regards,

Bruce

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: rebalancing the data
parts:
Hi Bruce,

Not supported in Rattle just yet but it would be a useful option.

Perhaps a "Balanced" check button on the Data tab before the "Seed:"
option? What R code do you use to do this (and what options to the
balancing do you employ)?

Not quite sure how it would work in the context of Partition. Perhaps,
if we are replicating the "ones" then we can ensure each partition is
also balanced?

Regards,
Graham
